2750.sigma:
title: Miasma v2 binding.gyp dropped into known-compromised npm package path
id: 9a82d401-77c5-4e0a-b1bd-5c8e6f2a90d3
description: Detects binding.gyp file writes inside node_modules subdirectories of the publicly named Miasma v2 / Phantom Gyp victims, which historically did not ship native add-ons
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/exploring-binding-gyp-npm-build-system
  - https://www.chainguard.dev/unchained/chainguard-artifacts-safe-from-miasma-phantom-gyp-npm-attack
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  filename:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\binding.gyp'
      - '/binding.gyp'
  victim_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'node_modules\@vapi-ai\server-sdk'
      - 'node_modules/@vapi-ai/server-sdk'
      - 'node_modules\ai-sdk-ollama'
      - 'node_modules/ai-sdk-ollama'
      - 'node_modules\@redhat-cloud-services'
      - 'node_modules/@redhat-cloud-services'
  condition: filename and victim_path
falsepositives:
  - A legitimate post-incident fixed version of these packages reintroducing a clean binding.gyp (verify SHA256 against published artifact)
level: high
2750.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="binding.gyp" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*node_modules*@vapi-ai*server-sdk*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*node_modules*ai-sdk-ollama*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*node_modules*@redhat-cloud-services*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_hash Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`

2753.sigma:
title: nebula-mesh CVE-2026-47724 Operator API Key Creation
id: 8c5b4f12-9a2d-4e3c-b6a1-7f3e1d8b9c01
status: experimental
description: Detects successful POST to nebula-mesh /api/v1/operators/{id}/api-keys, which on versions < 0.3.4 lacks admin/ownership checks (CVE-2026-47724) and lets any operator key mint a fresh bearer for any operator including admins.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-598g-h2vc-h5vg
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.t1078.003
  - attack.t1190
  - cve.2026.47724
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-method: POST
    cs-uri-stem|re: '^/api/v1/operators/[^/]+/api-keys/?$'
    sc-status:
      - 200
      - 201
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate admin provisioning new operator API keys via the admin UI
  - Automated key rotation scripts owned by the ops team
level: high
2753.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agents values(Web.status) as statuses from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" (Web.uri_path="/api/v1/operators/*/api-keys" OR Web.url="*/api/v1/operators/*/api-keys*") Web.status IN (200,201) by Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.uri_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=uri_path "/api/v1/operators/(?<target_operator_id>[^/]+)/api-keys"
| eval cve="CVE-2026-47724"
| table first_seen last_seen src user dest target_operator_id user_agents statuses count cve
| sort - last_seen

2754.sent:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowSec = 60;
let Reenroll = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/hosts/[^/]+/reenroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | extend VictimHostId = extract(@"/api/v1/hosts/([^/]+)/reenroll", 1, csUriStem)
    | project ReenrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent = csUserAgent;
let Enroll = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/enroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | project EnrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, EnrollAgent = csUserAgent;
Reenroll
| join kind=inner Enroll on cIP, Computer
| where EnrollTime between (ReenrollTime .. ReenrollTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EnrollTime, ReenrollTime)
| extend CVE = "CVE-2026-47724"
| project ReenrollTime, EnrollTime, DelaySec, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent, EnrollAgent, CVE
| order by ReenrollTime desc
2754.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" Web.uri_path="/api/v1/hosts/*/reenroll" Web.status IN (200,201) by _time Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.uri_path span=1s
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=uri_path "/api/v1/hosts/(?<victim_host_id>[^/]+)/reenroll"
| eval reenroll_time=_time, reenroll_count=count
| fields - count
| join type=inner src dest [
    | tstats summariesonly=t count as enroll_count from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method="POST" Web.uri_path="/api/v1/enroll" Web.status IN (200,201) by _time Web.src Web.dest span=1s
    | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
    | eval enroll_time=_time
    | fields enroll_time enroll_count src dest
  ]
| where enroll_time >= reenroll_time AND enroll_time <= reenroll_time + 60
| eval delay_sec=enroll_time - reenroll_time, cve="CVE-2026-47724"
| stats min(reenroll_time) as first_reenroll values(victim_host_id) as victim_hosts min(delay_sec) as min_delay_sec max(delay_sec) as max_delay_sec count by src user dest cve
| where count >= 1
| sort - first_reenroll

status: experimental
description: Detects operator-management state changes (disable, enable, API key revoke) on nebula-mesh < 0.3.4. handleDisableOperator (operators.go:79), handleEnableOperator (operators.go:94), and handleRevokeOperatorAPIKey (operators.go:157) all lack admin gates per the GHSA — any operator bearer can sabotage any peer.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-598g-h2vc-h5vg
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1531
  - attack.t1098
  - cve.2026.47724
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection_disable_enable:
    cs-method: POST
    cs-uri-stem|re: '^/api/v1/operators/[^/]+/(disable|enable)/?$'
    sc-status:
      - 200
      - 204
  selection_revoke:
    cs-method: DELETE
    cs-uri-stem|re: '^/api/v1/operators/[^/]+/api-keys/[^/]+/?$'
    sc-status:
      - 200
      - 204
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Admin legitimately offboarding an operator or rotating their keys
  - Bulk credential cleanup script run by ops
level: high
2757.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agents values(Web.uri_path) as paths from datamodel=Web where Web.status IN (200,201,204) AND ((Web.http_method="POST" AND (Web.uri_path="/api/v1/operators/*/disable" OR Web.uri_path="/api/v1/operators/*/enable")) OR (Web.http_method="DELETE" AND Web.uri_path="/api/v1/operators/*/api-keys/*")) by Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.http_method
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=paths "/api/v1/operators/(?<target_operator_id>[^/]+)/(?<action_seg>disable|enable|api-keys)"
| eval action=case(action_seg=="disable","operator_disable", action_seg=="enable","operator_enable", action_seg=="api-keys","api_key_revoke", true(),"other"), cve="CVE-2026-47724"
| table first_seen last_seen src user dest http_method action target_operator_id user_agents count cve
| sort - last_seen

title: AppleScript Code Injection via osascript Breakout Pattern (CVE-2026-47252 / Anyquery)

description: Detects exploitation of CVE-2026-47252 where anyquery's chrome_tabs plugin interpolates a SQL-controlled URL into an AppleScript template, allowing a payload to close the tell block, inject 'do shell script', and reopen a new tell block.

logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: macos

  selection_osascript:
    Image|endswith: '/osascript'
  selection_injection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'do shell script'

  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|contains: 'anyquery'
  condition: selection_osascript and selection_injection and selection_parent

  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-87m4-826x-3crx
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.004
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent_webworker:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/php-fpm'
      - '/php'
      - '/php-cgi'
      - '/apache2'
      - '/httpd'
      - '/nginx'
      - '\php-fpm.exe'
      - '\php.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
      - '\nginx.exe'
      - '\w3wp.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
      - '/curl'
      - '/wget'
      - '/nc'
      - '/ncat'
      - '/socat'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
      - '/perl'
      - '/ruby'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\wget.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
  condition: parent_webworker and child_lolbin
falsepositives:
  - Image processing pipelines (ImageMagick, ffmpeg) invoked via shell from PHP
  - Deployment / config-management agents shelling out from web context
  - Legitimate webhook handlers that exec system commands
level: medium
2765.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_path) as paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("php-fpm","php-fpm.exe","php","php.exe","php-cgi.exe","apache2","httpd","httpd.exe","nginx","nginx.exe","w3wp.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","zsh","ksh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","ncat.exe","socat","python","python3","python.exe","perl","ruby","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval cve="CVE-2026-45034"
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2765.datadog: (source:linux.auditd OR source:windows.sysmon) AND @process.parent.name:(*php-fpm* OR *php.exe OR php OR *apache2* OR *httpd* OR *nginx* OR *w3wp.exe*) AND @process.name:(sh OR bash OR dash OR zsh OR cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR pwsh.exe OR curl OR curl.exe OR wget OR wget.exe OR nc OR ncat OR socat OR python OR python3 OR perl OR certutil.exe OR bitsadmin.exe)

2767.def:
// Requires IIS / nginx access logs ingested to a custom table; M365 Defender XDR does not natively capture inbound HTTP to a self-hosted PHP app.
// Pivot via DeviceNetworkEvents for the web server's inbound traffic to the panel's listening port, then triage in the proxy/WAF.

| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where LocalPort in (80, 443, 8080, 8443)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","php-fpm.exe","php.exe","nginx.exe","httpd.exe","caddy.exe")
| where ActionType == "InboundConnectionAccepted"
| summarize Connections = count(), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by DeviceName, LocalIP, LocalPort, RemoteIP, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where Connections > 5
| order by LastSeen desc

2769.sent:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let TraversalTokens = dynamic(["log_dir_path","file_name_pattern","..%2F","..%2f","..%5C","..%5c","%2e%2e","path=%2F","path=/etc","path=/root","path=/home","path=/var","path=/tmp","log_dir_path=/"]);
let IISHits = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where csMethod =~ "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"(?i)^/[^/]+/start$"
    | where csUriQuery has_any (TraversalTokens) or csUriStem has_any ("%2e%2e", "..")
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, SrcIp=tostring(cIP), DstPort=tostring(sPort), Uri=csUriStem, Detail=csUriQuery, UA=csUserAgent, Source="W3CIIS";
let CEFHits = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RequestMethod =~ "POST"
    | where RequestURL matches regex @"(?i)/[^/]+/start(\?|$)"
    | where Message has_any (TraversalTokens) or RequestURL has_any ("%2e%2e", "..")
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=coalesce(DestinationHostName, DestinationDnsDomain, DeviceExternalID), SrcIp=SourceIP, DstPort=tostring(DestinationPort), Uri=RequestURL, Detail=Message, UA=RequestClientApplication, Source="CEF";
let SyslogHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ProcessName has_any ("ait-bsc","ait_bsc","bsc","python","python3")
    | where SyslogMessage has "/start" and SyslogMessage has_any (TraversalTokens)
    | project TimeGenerated, Host=Computer, SrcIp=HostIP, DstPort="", Uri="/<name>/start", Detail=SyslogMessage, UA="", Source="Syslog";
union IISHits, CEFHits, SyslogHits
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Hits=count(), SampleDetail=any(Detail) by Host, SrcIp, Uri, Source
| order by LastSeen desc

title: AIT-Core BSC Unauthenticated Path-Traversal POST (CVE-2026-47731)
id: 8f3b1a2c-9d4e-4f5a-b6c7-d8e9f0a1b2c3
description: Detects exploitation of CVE-2026-47731 — unauthenticated POST to the AIT-Core Binary Stream Capture /<name>/start endpoint carrying path-traversal-indicative form fields (log_dir_path, file_name_pattern, path) or %2e%2e/../ sequences that redirect the log_file write outside the configured root_log_directory.
references:
    - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p462-prxw-mjx4
author: Threat Hunter Notebooks
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.initial_access
    - cve.2026.47731
logsource:
    category: webserver
detection:
    selection_method:
        cs-method: POST
    selection_uri:
        cs-uri-stem|re: '(?i)^/[^/]+/start$'
    selection_payload:
        cs-uri-query|contains:
            - 'log_dir_path'
            - 'file_name_pattern'
            - '..%2F'
            - '..%2f'
            - '..%5C'
            - '%2e%2e'
            - 'path=%2F'
            - 'path=/etc'
            - 'path=/root'
            - 'path=/home'
            - 'path=/var'
    condition: selection_method and selection_uri and selection_payload
falsepositives:
    - Internal pen-test or vuln-scanner traffic (Tenable, Nessus, Burp Suite Pro)
    - Legitimate ait-bsc admin testing with unusual log_dir_path values
level: high
2769.spl:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Web.url) as urls values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agents from datamodel=Web where Web.http_method=POST AND (Web.uri_path="*/start" OR Web.url="*/start*") by Web.src Web.dest Web.uri_path Web.uri_query Web.url
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| where match(uri_path, "(?i)^/[^/]+/start$") AND (match(uri_query, "(?i)(log_dir_path|file_name_pattern|path)=") AND (match(uri_query, "(?i)(\.\.|%2e%2e|=%2[Ff]|=/etc/|=/home/|=/root/|=/var/|=/tmp/|=/usr/)") OR match(url, "(?i)(\.\.|%2e%2e)")))
| stats values(urls) as urls values(user_agents) as user_agents min(first_seen) as first_seen max(last_seen) as last_seen sum(count) as hits by src dest uri_path

    SampleURLs = make_set(RequestURL, 15),

    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),

    by SourceIP, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)

2941.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Laravel Lang Supply Chain Advisory
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("debugchromium.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/run/secrets/") or FileName in~ ("debugchromium.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

title: BadIIS-style Native Module Dropped Into IIS Path by Non-Installer Process
id: a3c0f1c8-8b62-4f1d-9c4e-d70e5c0e1f12
description: Detects file writes of DLL or EXE payloads into IIS-served directories (\inetsrv\, \inetpub\wwwroot\bin\) by a process that is NOT msiexec / TrustedInstaller / appcmd / drvinst. Aligns with Cisco Talos BadIIS commodity variant (May 2026) whose modules drop into IIS module paths and carry 'demo.pdb' strings.
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-art-of-being-ungovernable/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.004
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1036.005
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_paths:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\inetsrv\'
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\bin\'
      - '\inetpub\custerr\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.dll'
      - '.exe'
  filter_trusted_installers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\msiexec.exe'
      - '\TrustedInstaller.exe'
      - '\drvinst.exe'
      - '\appcmd.exe'
      - '\WindowsUpdateBox.exe'
      - '\TiWorker.exe'
  condition: selection_paths and not filter_trusted_installers
falsepositives:
  - Custom IIS deployment tooling outside of MSI / appcmd workflow
  - Web-app CI/CD pipelines that drop assemblies into bin\
level: medium

2974.sent:
let lookback = 7d;
let bucket = 1h;
let BadIISSignals = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where csMethod in~ ("GET","HEAD","POST")
| summarize Total = count(),
           Status503 = countif(scStatus == 503),
           Status3xx = countif(scStatus between (300 .. 399)),
           DistinctClients = dcount(cIP),
           DistinctURIs = dcount(csUriStem),
           SampleUserAgents = make_set(csUserAgent, 5),
           SampleReferers = make_set(csReferer, 5)
           by Computer, sSiteName, bin(TimeGenerated, bucket)
| extend PctErr503 = round((Status503 * 100.0) / Total, 2),
         PctRedirect = round((Status3xx * 100.0) / Total, 2)
| where (Status503 >= 50 and PctErr503 >= 20) or (Status3xx >= 100 and PctRedirect >= 40);
let Baseline = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(lookback))
| summarize BaselineTotal = count(),
           BaselineRedirect = countif(scStatus between (300 .. 399)),
           Baseline503 = countif(scStatus == 503)
           by Computer, sSiteName
| extend BaselinePctRedirect = round((BaselineRedirect * 100.0) / BaselineTotal, 2),
         BaselinePctErr503 = round((Baseline503 * 100.0) / BaselineTotal, 2);
BadIISSignals
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on Computer, sSiteName
| where PctRedirect >= (coalesce(BaselinePctRedirect, 0.0) * 3) or PctErr503 >= (coalesce(BaselinePctErr503, 0.0) * 3)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, sSiteName, Total, Status503, Status3xx, PctErr503, PctRedirect, BaselinePctRedirect, BaselinePctErr503, DistinctClients, DistinctURIs, SampleUserAgents, SampleReferers
| order by TimeGenerated desc

2988.def:

// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("timeago.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("timeago.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
